headline: Central Bank of Argentina adjusts currency band following inflation print
summary: Following a 1.93% inflation reading for September, the Central Bank of Argentina adjusted its currency exchange rate bands for November to establish intervention limits.
why: Exchange rate crawling peg adjustments and central bank intervention bands dictate currency volatility and inflation pass-through in stabilizing emerging economies.

impacts.name: USD/ARS
impacts.why: Central Bank adjusted currency trading bands following inflation data.
